text:
alex r.: morning! quick blocker: signed into redwood.okta.com but when I try to enroll Okta Verify it errors: 'Invalid enrollment token'. Also didn't get 1Password invite. starting today, who's best contact?
it-support: hey alex, welcome! looks like the common cause is the invite link expired or your account wasn't assigned the 1Password / Google apps yet. can you confirm alex.r@redwood.com and whether you clicked the initial email invite within 24h?
alex r.: yes alex.r@redwood.com. i clicked within a few hours. error screenshot: `Invalid enrollment token (E_ENROLL_EXPIRED)`. tried on laptop and phone.
dana: tagging infra-admin in case SCIM lag. alex, i'll DM you the onboarding checklist and add you to #team-sales.
it-support: infra-admin updated: user was created but missing "core-employees" group due to SCIM race. i added you, resent 1Password invite (SSO mode) and forced an Okta factor reset. Try the new link and open Okta Verify -> + -> Scan QR. If QR doesn't show, try incognito.
alex r.: new QR showed after incognito, scanned and approved. Okta sign-in works. 1Password invite arrived and i used "Sign in with Okta"  it opened SSO and I'm in. all good now, thanks!
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, alex! :tada: Checklist updated: Okta MFA enrolled, Google/1Password access confirmed. Join #new-hires lunch at 12pm.
